description: Lists a page of submissions for a specific routing form, including questions and answers and, when available, routing results and tracking data.

inputSchema.description: Request model for listing routing form submissions associated with a routing form.

count.description: Number of submissions to return per page. Defaults to 25 to keep responses manageable.
count.title: Count

form.description: The URI of the routing form whose submissions you want to retrieve. Required to identify which form's submissions to list.
form.title: Form

page_token.description: Pagination token for retrieving subsequent pages. Check pagination.next_page_token in the response; if non-null, pass it as page_token in the next call. Repeat until next_page_token is null.
page_token.title: Page Token

sort.description: Order results by field and direction. Format: 'field:direction'. Supported field: 'created_at'. Directions: 'asc', 'desc'.
sort.title: Sort

inputSchema.title: ListRoutingFormSubmissionsRequest

name: list_routing_form_submissions
